children: Pendle has taken PT Looping fully live out of beta, enabling one-click opening and closing of leveraged looping positions. The launch adds Borrow Out, redeem YT on exit, Repay Debt, a cost breakdown, estimated profit at maturity, a gas indicator, and a maturity filter. The tool has recorded roughly $50M in volume across 6 chains since its beta phase.

The one-click flow removes the manual steps of composing, managing, and unwinding leveraged fixed-yield positions, lowering the operational barrier for strategies that previously required separate transactions. Exit-side additions such as Repay Debt and redeeming YT on exit give users defined ways to close positions at or before maturity, while the cost breakdown and estimated profit display make expected outcomes visible before execution. Pendle has stated a plan to extend looping fees to PENDLE stakers, though fee streams from non-Pendle assets remain ahead rather than live.
PT Looping is now fully live and out of beta.
What used to take a tedious hour of manual supplying, borrowing and swapping....now takes one click, in and out ⚡

title: Pendle: PT Looping Exits Beta With One-Click Leveraged Looping - 23 Sep 2026
